## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the success and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] Public examples still execute.
- [ ] Posterior quantities are described as Bayesian summaries or credible intervals, not standard errors or confidence intervals.
- [ ] Validation claims are limited to the simulator, prior, representation, and training configuration actually tested.
- [ ] Artifact or API compatibility changes are documented.
- [ ] No private data, secrets, machine-specific paths, generated build output, or unrelated research files are included.
- [ ] I did not add an automatic publication or PyPI credential path.
